description.value: Akbar Joojeh is an authentic Persian restaurant established in 2024 on Lonsdale Avenue in North Vancouver, serving traditional Iranian dishes including signature saffron chicken, grilled kebabs, classic stews, and saffron rice. The restaurant operates two locations on Lonsdale and draws on family recipes and Iranian hospitality traditions. A third location in Los Angeles is listed as coming soon, suggesting a growing brand rooted in Persian culinary culture.
